name: wordmark
title: Wordmark
description: A name set in more than one script, stacked: "למה ככה" over "ليش هيك" over "WHYLIKEDIS". Each line is a `Wordmark.Line` with its own `lang` (and `dir` for a right-to-left script), so a screen reader, a hyphenator and the browser's font fallback all know…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/wordmark

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/wordmark.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/wordmark';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/wordmark

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
